description: A profile that selects `main` at `^0.1.0`, `old` at `>=2.0.0` and `missing` at any 1.x: `main` 0.1.3 is evaluated; `old` is given at 1.0.0, outside its range, and `missing` is not given, so each is FS-RULES-010; the rules of `old` and of `extra`, which the profile does not name, are listed as "profile".
